$comment: Baseline for apps/web/scripts/check-source-drift.mjs (.github/workflows/source-drift.yml). pages: one fingerprint per cited .edu or .gov URL other than PPLS labels and eCFR (HTTP status, Last-Modified, ETag, and a sha256 of the page text, or of the bytes for a PDF); refresh one after a reviewer confirmed its quotes with --only pages --update-fingerprints --url <url>. acknowledged: finding ids that need no data change, each with a reason a reviewer can check; an id names the state seen, so a later change shows up again. Never edit by hand to hide drift; see docs/research/source-refresh-prompt.md.
